The interface should display real-time portfolio performance, asset allocation charts, price trend graphs, and transaction history. Make it visually striking with a distinctive aesthetic that feels premium and trustworthy - avoid generic crypto app designs. Include interactive elements like hover states, animated counters, and smooth transitions. Use mock data for the demo. Target audience is serious crypto investors who want a professional-grade interface.
